programs.name: ANUBHOOTI
programs.description: A deep-dive research internship connecting students with premier research institutes across India. Work directly with faculty mentors on live projects.

programs.name: VIDHI
programs.description: Gain hands-on exposure to legal research, policy drafting, and governance frameworks under the mentorship of legal professionals.

programs.name: NITI
programs.description: Engage with think tanks and policy research organisations. Work on real governance challenges and present your findings to senior officers.

programs.name: SANSADIYA
programs.description: Work alongside Members of Parliament, understand legislative processes, and contribute to constituency-level research and development.

programs.name: SAMVAD
programs.description: A structured dialogue and mentorship program connecting student leaders with industry veterans and government officials.

programs.name: SHURUAT
programs.description: From idea validation to MVP ÔÇö an intensive entrepreneurship internship partnered with leading startup ecosystems and incubators.

programs.name: DEEKSHA
programs.description: On-ground social impact work across rural and semi-urban India. Work on development challenges alongside NGOs and government bodies.

institutes.name: IISER Bhopal

testimonials.name: Aryan Mehta
testimonials.quote: ANUBHOOTI didn't just give me a research experience ÔÇö it gave me a research identity. I worked on a machine learning model for crop disease detection and presented it to the institute faculty board. The mentorship was unparalleled.

testimonials.name: Priya Sharma
testimonials.quote: Walking the corridors of Parliament as an intern was surreal. Through SANSADIYA, I worked on constituency reports and helped draft policy briefs that were actually read by elected representatives.

testimonials.name: Rohan Verma
testimonials.quote: DEEKSHA took me out of my comfort zone ÔÇö and into a village in Karnataka where I helped set up a micro-lending network. Six weeks that changed my worldview more than six semesters in a classroom.

testimonials.name: Sneha Iyer
testimonials.quote: Through VIDHI, I worked on a comparative analysis of e-courts adoption across five states. The research directly fed into a ministry consultation paper.

testimonials.name: Karan Singh
testimonials.quote: SHURUAT was a fire drill for real startup life. I validated a SaaS idea, built an MVP in 3 weeks, and pitched to five real investors ÔÇö all within the program. Two of them asked for follow-up meetings.
testimonials.highlight: MVP built and investor interest secured

applicationSteps.title: DISCOVER
applicationSteps.description: Browse programs, institutes, and read intern diaries. Find the experience that aligns with your ambitions.

applicationSteps.title: SELECT
applicationSteps.description: Choose your program, preferred institute, and timeline. Bookmark opportunities for easy tracking.

applicationSteps.title: APPLY
applicationSteps.description: Submit your application with a statement of purpose, academic credentials, and two references.

applicationSteps.title: INTERVIEW
applicationSteps.description: Shortlisted candidates appear for a structured interview with the host institute faculty or HR panel.

applicationSteps.title: EXPERIENCE
applicationSteps.description: Report to your institute, begin your internship, and become part of the Think India alumni network.
